info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Customer Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Agreement Update API enables businesses to modify customer agreements based on specific parameters. This operation is essential for maintaining accurate and up-to-date customer management profiles, ensuring compliance and enhancing customer relations. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions and service providers who need to adapt customer agreements quickly to reflect changes in policies or regulations. Utilizing the PATCH method allows for partial updates, streamlining the process of managing customer data effectively.

patch.description: This endpoint allows the client to update the details of a specific customer agreement identified by its unique ID. Ensure to provide the required fields as part of the request body to modify the agreement successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update specific details of the customer agreement identified by CUST-100045. The payload should provide the necessary fields for the update as defined in the schema.

200.description: The request was successful, and the customer agreement has been updated.
